meta.aciklama:
Comment "REMEMBER" and I'll DM you the link to the free, open-source tool that gives Claude a memory of everything you worked on. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: how it works, and the catch.

1. It quietly saves notes on what you and Claude did in each session, then hands the right ones to Claude the next time you open a new chat.

2. Ask in plain words, like "what did we decide about pricing last week?", and it searches your past work and finds the answer.

3. It only pulls the notes it needs instead of your whole history, so you burn far fewer tokens (the project says about 10x).

4. Free and open source (Apache 2.0, past 112,000 GitHub stars), and your notes stay on your computer unless you turn on cloud sync.

The catch: it's built for Claude Code (Claude Desktop can search the memory through a skill), it needs Node.js, and the installer offers a hosted trial you can skip so memory runs on your own Claude plan.

For the link, follow and comment "REMEMBER"
